snippet.title: Aurora: Oasis Adventure - Playdate Teaser
snippet.description:
Hello there ! I have released my fist ever video game called Aurore: Oasis Adventure for the Playdate, Panic!'s yellow handheld.
You can download it on Itch today ! https://bananarider.itch.io/aurora-oasis-adventure 
I have made this game using the Pulp editor with zero prior coding experience. It was a fun project where I had to learn some basics of coding, game design, pixel "art", musical creation and even a bit of video editing with that trailer. I made everything myself ! The result is far from perfect but I'm happy with what I've done :)
I hope you will have a good time with it :)
